The '''Sirpar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sirpar/Legends|Sirpar]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Eklaad]] [[Species/Legends|species]].
